name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures NGINX to serve three TLS-enabled static virtual hosts, including site definitions and static assets. It also applies Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, and SSH hardening configuration.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, and log/PID directory handling. It also post-processes Redis replication-related configuration lines.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, and a systemd Uvicorn service. It provisions local PostgreSQL initialization, database/user configuration, and application environment settings.
